title: AD-AGENT: A Multi-agent Framework for End-to-end Anomaly Detection

claim.summary: AD-AGENT automates anomaly-detection pipelines across tabular, graph and time-series libraries using model selection, documentation retrieval, code generation/review and shared/cache memories.

modules.name: Executable code generation and dry-run repair
modules.scope_reason: Generator/reviewer repair execution errors through synthetic dry runs; mechanism is not anomaly-specific.

modules.name: Shared task state and cached model documentation
modules.scope_reason: Short-term inter-agent state and periodically refreshed documentation cache generalize across tools and modalities.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; 2.2 Agent Collaboration and Workflow

modules.name: Anomaly-library pipeline construction
modules.scope_reason: Model and optional hyperparameter selection target anomaly detection using PyOD, PyGOD and TSLib.
